newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end higher, await auction.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end higher, await auction.

text.p: Portuguese bonds closed firmer and dealers said they believed tomorrow's 10-year bond auction would confirm the buoyant trend.
"Prices will remain high as the Portuguese market continues to track peripherals," said one fixed-rate director.

"As today was a holiday in London, volume was not high," he added. "Ten-year bonds will continue to consolidate with a spread of around 90 basis points (bp) against Bunds, and tomorrow's 10-year bond auction should come out around secondary market levels."
The escudo closed weaker against the mark after an apathetic session. It ended at 100.45/47 per mark, compared with 100.32/35 at the opening.
